title: Can AI Get a Simple Maths Question Wrong?
description:
AI can make calculation and reasoning mistakes. Ask for steps and verify important answers.

A dad asks, his teen explains AI. AI Nation Studio — Imagine. Explore. Innovate.

lines.text: Can AI Get a Simple Maths Question Wrong? Really?
AI can make calculation or reasoning mistakes.

board.text: AI CAN MAKE CALCULATION OR REASONING MISTAKES.

lines.text: Even simple-looking questions can trip a model up.
Ask it to show the working, not just the answer.

board.text: ASK IT TO SHOW THE WORKING, NOT JUST THE ANSWER.

lines.text: Check the result with a calculator or trusted maths tool.
Use AI to learn, not as an unquestioned answer machine.

board.text: USE AI TO LEARN, NOT AS AN UNQUESTIONED ANSWER MACHINE

lines.text: What's the one thing I should remember?
Pause, check the details, and use your judgement before acting.
That sounds like a smart rule.
Exactly! Subscribe to AI Nation Studio, share this with a friend, and next time you use AI... remember this tip!
